summary.text: Jacqueline Coffie-Leeks is the Democratic nominee for Florida House of Representatives District 63; Ballotpedia lists her as member-elect after the November 3, 2026 general election was canceled.
An executive director, she describes herself in a Ballotpedia survey as a lifelong Tampa resident and community leader.

paragraphs.text: Jacqueline Coffie-Leeks said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that she was born in Sulphur Springs and raised in Tampa, and that she graduated from Hillsborough High School.
She said she attended the University of Florida, earned a bachelor's degree from Moody Bible Institute, and holds a certificate in non-profit management from the University of Tampa.
Her stated priorities include pathways to economic security, education and job training for young people, attainable housing, and support for seniors and caregivers.
